verses.text: For the music director. A psalm by the sons of Korah. Clap your hands, all you nations! Raise a victory shout to God! 👏
The LORD Most High is awesome. He's the great King over the whole earth.
He brings nations under our rule and puts peoples under our feet.
He picks out our inheritance for us, the glory of Jacob, whom he loved. Selah.
God has gone up with a shout, the LORD with the blast of a trumpet.
Sing praise to God! Sing praise! Sing praise to our King! Sing praise! 🎶
God is King over the whole earth. Sing praise with understanding.
God reigns over the nations. God sits on his holy throne.
The rulers of the peoples gather as the people of Abraham's God. The shields of the earth belong to God. He is lifted high!
